name: kind_transitions
description: The kind an entry keeps: NEAR and CONVERGING both raised -> NEAR; then only CONVERGING raised while still in hold (1.2 km) -> stays NEAR; only CONVERGING raised outside hold (2 km) -> becomes CONVERGING; then nothing raised but in hold, no closest approach now -> held CONVERGING reads 'TRAFFIC CONVERGING WITH <id>' without seconds; out of hold 20 s -> cleared.
worked_example: D9A03 hovers at alt_geo 150 m; UAL123 flies at 100 kt = 51.44 m/s, alt_geom 200 m (50 m above).

t=0: 800 m N heading S (180): NEAR (800 <= 1000) and CONVERGING (CPA 800 / 51.44 = 15.55 s, miss 0) both raised -> shown as NEAR: 'TRAFFIC NEAR DRONE D9A03' / 'GIVE WAY: DESCEND AND LAND D9A03; AIRCRAFT 50 M ABOVE, 800 M N, CLOSEST IN 16 S'.
t=5: 1200 m N, still heading S: NEAR is not raised (1200 > 1000) but CONVERGING is (CPA 23.33 s) and the pair is in hold (1200 <= 1300) -> the entry stays NEAR, not held: 'TRAFFIC NEAR DRONE D9A03'.
t=10: 2000 m N heading S: only CONVERGING raised and outside hold (2000 > 1300) -> the entry becomes CONVERGING: 'TRAFFIC CONVERGING WITH D9A03, 39 S'.

t=15: 1200 m N heading N (away): nothing raised, no closest approach, in hold -> held CONVERGING without seconds: 'TRAFFIC CONVERGING WITH D9A03' / 'GIVE WAY: DESCEND AND LAND D9A03; AIRCRAFT 50 M ABOVE, 1.2 KM N'.
t=20: 1400 m -> out of hold; t=39 (19 s) still shown; t=40 cleared (its LOW, hidden under the warning until then, shows: 1.4 km from the drone, 180 m above ground).

Also LOW (UAS airspace: airborne, within 3 km of the observer or a live drone, below 460 m above ground; ground = the observer's elevation 20 m): a1b2c3 at t=40 'LOW TRAFFIC N 1.4 KM' ('BE READY TO LAND DRONES; AIRCRAFT 180 M ABOVE GROUND, 1.4 KM N'). A warning for the same aircraft supersedes its LOW, which shows again once the warning clears.
